description: Prepare a canonical prompt and instructions for comparing at least two targets, including one to five custom BYOM models and optional supported built-in AI providers. API keys must not appear in the comparison plan; use run_custom_model to execute custom targets separately. Returns comparison targets and prompt without invoking any models. This is a Send action requiring an active Apple-authorized introductory trial, active Pro subscription, or existing unexpired legacy app-managed trial. MCP cannot start an Apple subscription or paid trial.

builtinProviders.description: Optional built-in provider IDs to include alongside custom targets. This preparation tool does not call providers.

customModels.description: Required array of 1 to 5 custom model connection descriptors; excludes authentication credentials.

adapterMode.description: Adapter type for this model's API.

baseUrl.description: Public HTTPS base URL for an OpenAI-compatible model.

endpoint.description: Public HTTPS inference URL for a custom REST model.

label.description: Human-readable name of the custom model in the comparison results.

inputLanguage.description: Language name or code of input text, e.g. es; defaults to EN.

outputLanguage.description: Requested output language name or code, e.g. fr; defaults to EN.

prompt.description: Required canonical prompt shared among all selected models, up to 30,000 characters.

uiLanguage.description: Interface language name or code, e.g. EN; independent of source and response languages.

name: prepare_custom_compare
title: Prepare custom Compare Mode
